name: bible-end-times-astro
description: Biblical studies with interactive timeline and dual calendar views (Gregorian & Zadok)

scripts.test: node --test scripts/build-events.test.js && node src/utils/calendarConvert.test.js && node src/utils/bibleReference.test.js && node src/utils/chronology.test.js
scripts.build:tools: npm run build:events && esbuild src/entries/genealogy.jsx src/entries/timeline.jsx src/entries/references.jsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outdir=../docs/content/assets/js --minify
scripts.dev:tools: npm run build:events && esbuild src/entries/genealogy.jsx src/entries/timeline.jsx src/entries/references.jsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outdir=../docs/content/assets/js --watch
